author: jracer15
body:
For my next walls map it is a spaced themed walls map with an added effect of jump boost and slowness to feel gravity like!  The map has a serious of things, to a endstone terrain, crash-landed rocket ships, UFO's ship for a middle, instead of trees logs are set different, the usual walls stuff like caves, of course, and it comes with its own story!

Story

You find yourself crash-land with you and your team in an unknown planet.  Signs of no living, but you realize you've haven't been the only ones to crash here.  Several crash landed rocket ships wonder along this mysterious planet and you ask yourself, there is a conspiracy to this all.  Explore around this vast land and find hidden places and much more to learn the truth of where gravity has taken you...

Download with YML!

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Great idea, map, and concept. Nice story as well! C:

I find it interesting how you added jump boost + slowness to emulate lower gravity levels. Good idea in the endstone terrain and lots of caves to explore, from what I can see. The terrain seems a bit plain, but you covered it nicely with the structures.

The one thing I'm not a big fan of is the UFO in the middle. Looks a bit rushed in terms of detailing, but other than that I think it's a great map! (though I'm not much of a Walls person sadly)

+1 :D
